decision_rule: Arabic psychometric evidence, access to the exact Arabic source form, and reproduction/translation rights are three separate gates. Publication of full fixed item wording requires all applicable gates to pass.

states.rawafid-operational: Arabic operational worksheet authored by Rawafid for a performance/generic numeric procedure; not claimed as a validated Arabic translation unless explicitly stated.
states.validated-source-ready: Arabic validation evidence and an authoritative source/distribution route are identified; use the exact authorized version.
states.validated-form-access-pending: Arabic validation exists but the exact validated source form was not retrieved/verified for republication in this release.
states.owner-controlled: Arabic version may exist, but the instrument/translation is distributed or licensed by its owner; do not mirror item wording.
states.evidence-limited: Arabic evidence or exact version provenance is insufficient for a full publication decision.

instruments.name: Timed Up and Go
instruments.arabic_validation: Not required to label Rawafid procedure wording as an operational worksheet; population-specific measurement evidence still governs interpretation.
instruments.rights: No fixed questionnaire item bank reproduced.

instruments.name: 30-Second Chair Stand Test
instruments.arabic_validation: Rawafid procedure worksheet, not an Arabic validation claim.
instruments.rights: Physical performance procedure; fixed proprietary item wording is not reproduced.

instruments.name: 4-Stage Balance Test
instruments.arabic_validation: Rawafid Arabic operational rendering of CDC STEADI procedure.
instruments.rights: CDC government source; Rawafid worksheet is independently formatted.

instruments.name: 10 Meter Walk Test
instruments.arabic_validation: Procedure worksheet; interpretation must match protocol/population.
instruments.rights: No fixed proprietary questionnaire items reproduced.

instruments.name: Five Times Sit to Stand Test
instruments.arabic_validation: Procedure worksheet; chair height/end point must be fixed.
instruments.rights: No fixed questionnaire item set reproduced.

instruments.name: Numeric Pain Rating Scale
instruments.arabic_validation: Generic 0–10 numeric interface; reference period and population-specific MDC/MCID must be specified.
instruments.rights: Generic numeric rating implementation; no proprietary item bank.

instruments.name: Patient-Specific Functional Scale
instruments.arabic_validation: Modern Standard Arabic cross-cultural adaptation in lower-extremity musculoskeletal disorders; ICC 0.86, SEM 0.64, MDC 1.49 in the published study.
instruments.rights: Rawafid does not reproduce a fixed item bank; activities are generated by the patient.

instruments.name: Short Physical Performance Battery
instruments.arabic_validation: Rawafid operational Arabic rendering; not presented as an independently validated Arabic translation.
instruments.rights: NIA states no permission or royalty fees; NIH CDE records Copyright: No.

instruments.name: Roland-Morris Disability Questionnaire 24
instruments.arabic_validation: Modern Standard Arabic validation/cross-cultural adaptation is published.
instruments.rights: ePROVIDE states the original and all translations are public domain and may be reproduced without permission.

instruments.name: Pain Disability Index
instruments.arabic_validation: A 2026 Modern Standard Arabic validation study reports the final Arabic form in its supplementary appendix.
instruments.rights: The validation article describes PDI as public domain; exact validated Arabic appendix must still be source-verified before mirroring.

instruments.name: Berg Balance Scale
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic BBS demonstrated reliability and validity in 82 Arabic-speaking people with vestibular disorders in Jordan and Saudi Arabia.
instruments.rights: Use exact version provenance and rights source; do not reconstruct Arabic task/scoring wording from secondary sites.

instruments.name: Mini-BESTest
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic cross-cultural adaptation reported excellent total/internal-domain reliability and validity in neurological balance disorders.
instruments.rights: Exact developer/owner terms and source form must be verified before mirroring.

instruments.name: Lower Extremity Functional Scale
instruments.arabic_validation: 20-item Arabic adaptation showed ICC 0.96, SEM 3.5 and MDC95 9.8; later Rasch work questioned unidimensionality of the 20-item form and supported a refined 15-item Arabic form that requires independent confirmation.
instruments.rights: Do not infer republication permission from validation publication; exact form/version rights must be verified.

instruments.name: Oswestry Disability Index
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic adaptations/validations have been published, including Saudi Arabian and earlier Arab-population studies.
instruments.rights: Version control and permission may apply; obtain the exact authorized Arabic version from its official distribution route.

instruments.name: Neck Disability Index
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic NDI study reported Cronbach alpha 0.89 and test-retest ICC 0.96, with construct validity and responsiveness evidence.
instruments.rights: Validation does not itself grant Rawafid republication rights; verify copyright holder/version and authorized Arabic form.

instruments.name: QuickDASH
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic QuickDASH had alpha 0.90, ICC 0.91, SEM 7.0 and MDC 16.3 in upper-extremity musculoskeletal disorders; the study notes the Arabic form is available on the official DASH site.
instruments.rights: Use official Institute for Work & Health distribution; do not mirror its fixed items on Rawafid without applicable permission.

instruments.name: EuroQol EQ-5D / EQ-5D-5L
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic EQ-5D has validation evidence in Jordan and Saudi Arabia, with additional EQ-5D-5L validation in clinical populations.
instruments.rights: EuroQol manages registration/licensing and translations; use the official version for the exact intended context.

instruments.name: WHO Disability Assessment Schedule 2.0
instruments.arabic_validation: A 2026 Rasch validation in 486 Arabic-speaking people with disabilities reported strong person/item reliability and broadly supportive validity, while identifying one item needing revision.
instruments.rights: Use the official WHO Arabic form and WHO terms; do not substitute Rawafid-created fixed item wording.

instruments.name: WHOQOL-BREF
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic WHOQOL-BREF has validation evidence in a large Kuwaiti general-population sample and in Jordanian family caregivers, among other populations.
instruments.rights: Use WHO's official language version and applicable WHO terms.

instruments.name: SF-36v2 Health Survey
instruments.arabic_validation: A Saudi Arabic SF-36v2 translation underwent qualitative and quantitative psychometric validation with Saudi normative data.
instruments.rights: Licensed/owner-controlled survey; use an authorized translation and scoring route.

instruments.name: Knee injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score-12
instruments.arabic_validation: The first Arabic KOOS-12 cross-cultural adaptation was published in 2026 with excellent internal consistency, test-retest reliability and convergent validity.
instruments.rights: Use the official KOOS/translation route and verify terms for the exact Arabic version before mirroring fixed items.

instruments.name: Hip disability and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score
instruments.arabic_validation: An Arabic HOOS cross-cultural adaptation/validation has been published; interpretation should follow the exact studied long-form version.
instruments.rights: HOOS translations/version governance applies; ePROVIDE notes exclusive linguistic-validation management for HOOS-12 and license conditions for that version.

instruments.name: Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index
instruments.arabic_validation: Arabic/Tunisian adaptation evidence exists, but the original-form construct validity was not supported in an early Sfax study and a modified physical-function subscale was proposed; version/population details matter.
instruments.rights: Copyrighted/owner-controlled; no fixed item reproduction on Rawafid.

instruments.name: Montreal Cognitive Assessment
instruments.arabic_validation: Official Arabic language versions are managed through MoCA; population/version-specific evidence should be checked for the intended use.
instruments.rights: Owner-controlled instrument; training/certification and use conditions may apply.
